mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOMS (name, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CHAT_ROOMS WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT cr.* FROM CHAT_ROOMS cr JOIN USER_CHAT_ROOMS ucr1 ON cr.id = ucr1.chat_room_id JOIN USER_CHAT_ROOMS ucr2 ON cr.id = ucr2.chat_room_id WHERE ucr1.user_id = #{userId1} AND ucr2.user_id = #{userId2} AND cr.name LIKE '% - %' GROUP BY cr.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ucr1.user_id) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ucr2.user_id) = 1
